design.task: Write a handoff to a senior backend engineer from the supplied incident notes.
design.model_control: Two independent agents using the same model and base prompt.
design.treatment: The Cablegram agent read and applied skill/SKILL.md; the baseline agent was instructed not to read or use it.
design.fact_evaluation: Manual explicit-presence check against the critical_facts list

critical_facts: 3 log occurrences during parallel token refresh
correlation only; root cause not confirmed
restart restores operation for approximately 20 minutes, then recurrence
do not deploy before multi-instance testing
no authentication bypass or credential exposure observed

runs.name: Baseline agent
runs.output:
Investigate the authentication service at `src/auth/session.ts:118`. During parallel token refresh, logs show three occurrences where the Redis connection pool reached its configured maximum of 50. This is correlation only; the root cause is not confirmed. When the condition occurs, login requests return HTTP 503.

Restarting the service restores operation for approximately 20 minutes, after which the issue recurs. The proposed fix is a per-session mutex around refresh, but do not deploy it until multi-instance behavior has been tested.

Next, reproduce the issue with four instances under 200 requests/second. No authentication bypass or credential exposure was observed.

limitations: Single task and one run per condition
